Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

amphiBR 0.1.0

  • New dataset drummond2026, with the 2026 edition of the List of Amphibians of Brazil (Drummond, Santana, Lima & Toledo 2026, Herpetologia Brasileira 15(2), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18340087): 1,251 species (1,206 Anura, 40 Gymnophiona, 5 Caudata).
  • drummond2026$category gives the national threat category by the Portaria MMA nº 1.704, de 16 de junho de 2026 (Annexes I and II).
  • drummond2026$status records the change of each species relative to Segalla et al. (2021); data-raw/mudancas_2021_2026.csv lists all changes, including the 41 removed species (25 without confirmed records in Brazil and 16 junior synonyms) and 63 new combinations.
  • data-raw/ has the scripts that extract the list from the original PDF and the Portaria from the Diário Oficial da União, and build the dataset.
  • segalla2021 is unchanged.

Developed by Paulo Barros de Abreu Junior, Mauricio Humberto Vancine, Diogo B. Provete.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
